IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset]( [RuleID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [SecurityAsset] [char](1) NOT NULL, [SecurityAssetID] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [RuleID] ASC, [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset_SecurityAsset-SecurityAssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset_SecurityAsset-SecurityAssetID] ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] ( [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC ) END
